job.title: SQLI Senior Front End Developer (Vue / Nuxt)

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer
cover_en.hook: Your opening for an SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer at SQLI immediately caught my attention as it matches my core expertise. I bring over 5 years of professional experience building, extending and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms for major global clients such as Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: OCC APIs & Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and designed PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Performance & Maintenance
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, while executing CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2).

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Acted in a techno-functional capacity, analysing integration problems with business and technical teams, writing user stories and functional specifications, and supporting international stakeholders.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend and integration experience can support SQLI.

tailoring.why_company: SQLI delivers exceptional digital commerce experiences for leading global enterprises, aligning perfectly with my 5+ years of specialized experience engineering robust backends on SAP Commerce Cloud. I am eager to contribute my deep Java, Spring, OCC REST API and integration expertise to your talented international teams.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud backend engineering experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell to deliver high-performance e-commerce solutions at SQLI.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud backend engineering experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer role at SQLI. I bring deep Java, Spring and integration expertise. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Backend Platform Engineer position at SQLI.

With over 5 years of professional experience building and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, PIM/ERP integrations and database performance tuning.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit. I am serving a notice period until 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026.

I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your requirements.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
